fml.menu.mods.info.description.compact_f: A Create add-on for Minecraft 1.21.1 NeoForge. Shrink whole bulk-supply installations into a single block—without discounting a single part or resource.
compact_facilities.configuration.title: Compact Facilities Server Config
compact_facilities.configuration.require: Spout operations required for a new fluid source (1,000 mB each). Set to 0 to follow Create's Hose Pulley threshold.
